data_fields.donor_constant: head -40, left arm -30, right arm -30, torso 0, right leg -20, left leg -20, eyes -60, groin -30, uncalled 0

data_fields.donor_constant: player head crit table: 3 for effects 0 to 4, 6 for effect 5

best_idea: Resolve a hit as one d100 under a capped accuracy number, let the margin above the roll decide a second crit roll, then mitigate damage as a flat threshold first and a percent resistance second.
decision_why: Take the two-roll shape (hit under accuracy, crit from the margin) and the flat-then-percent mitigation order into src/fight/hit.ts with Frankendom's own numbers; reject the day-gated crits, the copied perk and location tables, and the animation-driven knockback, since the donor licence is non-commercial and only the shape may be used.
acceptance: A server test with a seeded stream: an accuracy of 120 is capped to 95 and misses about 5 percent of 10,000 swings; raw 10 with threshold 3 and resistance 20 percent deals 6; with crits disabled no swing reports a crit.
